how: We read the website of every San Diego wedding DJ listed on Lazo (51 listings, 37 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: out-of-state and national DJ chains with a San Diego page, a Maui destination DJ, a pianist, a karaoke host and a venue that landed in this category. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Who exactly will be at my wedding, and can I talk to that DJ before I sign?
How do you handle ceremony audio outdoors, where wind off the water and park noise limits are the issue?
What is in the base price, and what are uplighting, photo booth and extra hours on top?

picks.name: The Wedding Entertainment Collective
picks.blurb: The Wedding Entertainment Collective fields a roster where every DJ brings a different sound, so you match the vibe, not just the date. Pricing starts at $2,500 with no travel fees within 100 miles of San Diego and no time limit on single-day events; the site cites 1,000-plus weddings and 20-plus years.

picks.name: MY DJs Live Entertainment & Production
picks.blurb: Earl Henry founded Musically Yours DJs, known as MyDJS, in his garage and grew it over 20 years into a DJ and event production company. Weddings and corporate events across San Diego, Temecula and Los Angeles, with a wedding FAQ on the site.

picks.name: Sound Prodigy
picks.blurb: Sound Prodigy's pitch is the people it employs: DJs with 10 to 30 years of experience, each with a bio on the site, and office manager Tamara Connolly with more than 15 years in weddings. Mobile wedding DJ services for San Diego County, starting with a consultation.

picks.name: Pro Motion Entertainment
picks.blurb: Pro Motion Entertainment is DJ Blake Miller's DJ and MC service with event lighting, a photo booth and audio-visual production. Couples plan through an online system, and the site publishes song lists for every moment from processional to garter toss.

picks.name: Southcoast Production Group
picks.blurb: A small husband-and-wife mobile DJ and photo booth business in San Diego that keeps prices reasonable because it is just the two of them. Southcoast Production Group covers Southern California from Orange County to the High Desert, with a wireless mic and ceremony timeline in its wedding setup.

picks.name: The LoveTap
picks.blurb: The LoveTap says your wedding deserves a better DJ: each of its DJs has 10-plus years in top nightclubs, and the signature offering is DJ plus live saxophone. Full audio-visual for weddings and destination events out of San Diego.

picks.name: DJ Misha
picks.blurb: DJ Misha has played weddings, corporate events and parties since 2001, spinning dance and house with a collector's devotion to vinyl. The DJ and saxophone duo is the option for couples who want live instrument energy on the floor.

picks.name: Dancing DJ Productions
picks.blurb: Dancing DJ Productions began in 2001 as owner Will Chitwood's one-man show and has grown into a team that has done over 9,000 Southern California events. The site counts 35 awards and preferred-vendor status at more than 100 venues, and calls itself the most reviewed DJ company in San Diego.

picks.name: DJ Tigerlily California
picks.blurb: Lily Shevitz, DJ Tigerlily California, is a female DJ and MC in Vista for weddings and corporate parties, with lighting available. Her site lists the North County venues she has played, from Agua Hedionda Lagoon to Grand Traditions and Paradise Point.

picks.name: Bwatt Entertainment
picks.blurb: Bwatt Entertainment has served Southern California since 2004 with a DJ who has been in the music business over 25 years and offers event-organizing advice and referrals along with the music. Sound, lighting, music and video for weddings, out of Santee.

picks.name: Pure Energy DJ Service
picks.blurb: DJ Ruben of Pure Energy is a DJ and MC with 15 years in the industry across San Diego County, bilingual in English and Spanish and used to weddings, corporate events and clubs. The site leads with his personality and detail-oriented approach.

picks.name: Partypam.com
picks.blurb: Party Pam is a female San Diego DJ who sees weddings from both the bride's and the entertainer's side, and lists LGBT parties among her specialties. She cites a WeddingWire Couples' Choice award and a Knot Best of Weddings win, and wants the party to be fun above all.
